description: Real-time stock data via Yahoo Finance. Returns price, change, change_pct, previous_close, market_cap, pe_ratio, week_52_high, week_52_low, volume, and market_state. Max 10 symbols per call. Non-US exchange suffixes: 'SAP.DE' (Xetra), 'VOD.L' (London LSE), 'AIR.PA' (Paris Euronext), 'ASML.AS' (Amsterdam). Price: $0.002 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"symbols":["AAPL","MSFT"]}.

symbols.description: List of stock ticker symbols. Max 10 per call. Examples: ['AAPL', 'MSFT', 'NVDA'] for US stocks, ['SAP.DE', 'BAYN.DE'] for German XETRA stocks, ['TSLA', 'GOOGL', 'AMZN']. Use the exchange suffix for non-US stocks (e.g. .DE, .L, .PA).
